When the Printing Crew arrive, we learn how they work together to mix their colours and create new ones.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing, Hoppity, his friends and their toys are playing superheroes in the park. When Bing and Hoppity rescue Flop from the giant spider, Bing falls off the climbing rope. He is alright, but Hoppity has had an accident: his bottom is broken! Sula, Pando and Flop help an upset Bing rescue Hoppity and then take him to Amma's, where she can sew him back together.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Everyone wants to win Swoppiton’s hide-and-seek tournament. But Mojo and Bo accidentally break the prize. They need to put it back together without the seeker spotting them!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The circus has come to town and the Squirrels are very excited until they see that it is a flea circus. It is so tiny! It doesn't seem very impressive until they get to see some of the acts, like Fifi and her daring tightrope act and the flea cannonball. The Squirrels are eager to get involved, especially when they see what the strong flea can do - now that's impressive!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: One of the chickens is laying her eggs. One chick, two chicks and OOPS! The third chick's legs pop out of the bottom of the egg. Oh dear, it's a little bit stuck! Wait a minute - the egg is running off! Can the Squirrels help bring it back to the chicken safely? There's a big world out there to explore so the Squirrels need to be quick. Oh, and they must make sure they find the right egg to return!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners, so he can ask Mum out on a date.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Both Uncle Rad and Frisky accidently turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: When Grandmaster Glitch discovers his Halloween pumpkin isn't as big as the Grimbots' one, he goes in search of some fertilizer to help it grow. Meanwhile, Xuli is testing her new sonar-equipped GO Dive at the Gua Rusa cave in Borneo. Gua Rusa is so big, a jumbo jet could fly through it. It's home to millions of bats, and Glitch is after all the bat droppings to use as pumpkin fertiliser!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Benjamin accidentally loses Peter's dad's journal, it falls into the clutches of Mr Tod.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: The Octonauts follow a trail of deep-sea debris to its source: a derelict ship floating unmanned on the surface. But the ship seems to be haunted by ghostly voices, which a quick dip below the water line reveals to be hundreds of barnacles stuck to the ship. As the ship drifts into waters too cold for the barnacles, the Octonauts must find a way to tow it to warmer waters before it sinks or falls apart.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: One goes in search of the legendary One Times Table. Sing along and learn the One Times Table with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. O has fun doubling up and making new and different oo sounds in the words moon, foot and boot. He even gets to hoot like an owl!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piripenguins help Norman the whale by entertaining a family of touring crabs with an energetic youngster, but can the gang satisfy her constant demands and win them over?

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog cures Fifi’s hiccups with a big dragon roar. But when patients are too scared to be treated by him, Zog must choose between being a scary dragon or a doctor.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: It’s pumpkin-picking day at Jackson’s farm, but something spooky has been scaring all the pumpkin pickers. Mojo and Bo need to find out what's going on, and chase some ghosts!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula’s cousin Nicky is visiting, something Bing is a little unsure about. Sula and Bing start making 'rippy pictures', and while Sula is looking for some purple paper Bing shows Nicky how to voosh the blue speedy car down the slide. However, Nicky vooshes too, falling and breaking his glasses! Sula is furious and Bing is forlorn. Amma soothes Bing while Nicky shows him that he can click his glasses back together again.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘present’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different presents - a wrapped-up present, one with a bow, another for a birthday and a present to make you feel better. There are some for parties, one made by a squirrel and another that is just because! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: When Nana and Dado ask Maddie and Triggs to help prune Mum's willow tree, they are shocked to learn that this means cutting off all its branches! Their shock soon turns to delight when they learn pruning will help the tree, and they are even more delighted by all the wonderful things Dado can make with the branches.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The full moon makes Wilf howl all night! The next morning, everyone is exhausted - and there’s a boulder blocking Brian’s door! He’s the only one who knows how to stop Wilf’s howling, so they need to budge that boulder.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos find themselves in a sports hall. They watch a gymnast dance whilst twirling a ribbon. Toodloo copies the gymnast, twirling a ribbon. Chickedy and Chick join in and Great BigHoo tries too, but he ends up twirling his ribbon around Toodloo, Chickedy and Chick. The Very Important Lady visits the Big Red Boat. Music starts to play and the Very Important Lady performs a twirling dance. She twirls all the Twirlywoos around too.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Meet some cute alpacas with Justin and his friend as they visit a farm, while Mr Tumble, Grandad Tumble and Aunt Polly sing Old MacDonald at the farmyard dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: As the Teletubbies say eh-oh to their reflections in a puddle, Dipsy's hat falls in and gets wet - oops! Dipsy sings a sad song, but then the sun shines and the wind blows, and his hat is dry again in no time! In Tummy Tales, the Teletubbies watch children enjoying their reflections in a Scottish loch.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Nigel and Baby Bear welcome babies Addi, Bonnie, Ian, Gracie, Connor, Dhilan and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are Gloves which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate gloves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun nursery rhyme ‘Incy Wincy Spider’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee plays I-spy next to a beautiful lake with her new friend Olivia.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Worm farmer Heather and the Fact Pack get hands-on with wiggly worms! We learn how wonderful worms help plants grow.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk by the seaside and along the beach to build sandcastles. On the way, they make sounds using the wind, walk on the moon, spot windsurfers and even find a mermaid’s purse!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: The two friends celebrate the joys of greeting.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a very windy day, and the Squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly. Well done Squirrels! What brilliant flags!

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: We help Kush find out all about buzzy, busy bumblebees! Ferne visits a wildflower garden to find different types of bees, while Rory and his son Sandy visit the park looking for bumblebees. They then return home to build their own bumblebee house. Plus, we find out how bumblebees help to make a third of all the food we eat by a process called pollination.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: George and Freddie love having fun! After a hearty breakfast, they fill their day with family 'eggsperiments', art, and even set up an obstacle course for Mum and Dad to complete. It looks easy at first… until they learn they have to do it blindfolded!

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen and Small want to cook pillow samosas for Princess Sprout, but they have run out of peas. Small flies on her spoon to find some in order to make the perfect recipe.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika and her family are on a day out to the Woofton Transport Museum. But when their new audio guide starts malfunctioning, Kika needs her supersight to race back through the museum.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s a new day, and Mrs Farrell is checking in with all the children to see how they are. Lucas tells her he is looking for more friends to play with, and there are lots of volunteers! Isla, Otto and Jud bake some delicious tiger ginger biscuits, using coloured icing for roar-some decorations. At playtime, Jud asks if she can play with Lucas, and they have a fun-filled game of chase. The day ends with carpet-time, and Lucas is happy with his new-found friends.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba isn't well and needs to rest in the burrow. Oona has an idea to help him feel better. She travels across the island asking their friends to help her with her plan - they're going to bring Baba all his favourite things. Oona begins to doubt herself when it seems like Baba's not so interested in them - until their friends arrive!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: TapTap’s loud, fast drumming is driving everyone in the garden to distraction. Can Yukee and Twinkle find a way to show TapTap that fast doesn’t necessarily have to mean loud?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs want to get their toy train all the way from Phillipsburg to Maddiesville, but Phillip is finding it hard to let go of his dream track layout. Can he find a way to listen to Maddie's ideas so that the train can keep going round and round?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: It's the hottest day of the year in Fine Forest. The Piggies build an ice machine for cold drinks. Wilf wants it all to himself - and accidentally causes a blizzard!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Welcome to Ten's Place, where trainer Ten puts her friends through their paces with a high-energy number workout. Learn about numbers that are 'ten-and-a-bit' with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The Alphablocks join in with a singalong song, in which birds sing and bells ring. This episode introduces the '-ng' digraph and the words sing, song, ring, king, ting, ping, ding, dong, pong and bang.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin goes on an outdoor adventure with his friend. They build a den, meet an owl and sing around a campfire. Meanwhile, the Tumble family go on a camping trip, but Aunt Polly's snoring keeps everyone awake!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pretend to fly. Po goes so fast on the scooter that it starts to fly over Teletubbyland! The children in Tummy Tales watch swans flying.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby elephant Kipekee learns how to get rid of some buzzy flies with the help of her friends. Ranger Hamza spots lions in the wild and has fun playing with the baby rhinos.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the name bracelet and remembers the day she got it… Daisy is wearing a bracelet the others haven’t seen before. It’s a name bracelet with her Nigerian middle name, Eniwaju, on it. Her grandmother gave it to her. Molly has the idea to make their own name bracelets. Eilidh tells Daisy that she also has a Nigerian middle name; Ayodele. Meanwhile, Mack is doing a favour for Alice. He is posting a Japanese puzzle box from her stall to a customer. The only problem is, he can’t find it amongst all of Alice’s near and far treasures. When he finally spots the puzzle box, Suki and Molly give him a fright, and he drops it!

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing green machines! Grace drives a futuristic solar racecar, shows off an electric ferry and goes fishing for rubbish in a boat made out of recycled plastic bottles.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's show and tell day, and it's Bertie's turn to share why he loves gardening with the class. The pups are keen to give it a go but haven't fully listened to how it should be done. When Bertie mentions digging, Dodge gets carried away. Together with the pups, they end up ruining the garden. Bertie gets cross and feels upset. Dodge and Bertie both realise their mistakes, apologise, and become friends again.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger discovers some unexpected guests hiding in her tail - three baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a blizzard hits, Captain Barnacles will need to use all his Arctic survival tactics.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Cheeky Peter Rabbit loves adventure but he struggles to stay out of trouble. Luckily his best friends are always around to help him out. Based on Beatrix Potter's classic stories.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Banjo gets a worry tummy when he paints a mural for everyone in Sweetwood.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it’s too late!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings, the Eaglets and the Chipmunk are having a race! When Weasy realises that his Ducklings are going to lose, he decides to cheat - but Papa Eagle sees through his scheme.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: Wizz discovers a secret pirate map but wants to find the gold before you can see it.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners, so he can ask Mum out on a date.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Both Uncle Rad and Frisky accidently turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Feeling unappreciated, Gadabout discovers a talent for gardening. Zog and Pearl discover his green fingers have upset the natural balance of the land, making others ill.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is tracking all the dinosaurs on Dino Island to find out when they move from one part of the island to another in search of food or shelter. She asks Andy to find a herd of triceratops and place one of her tracking devices on them. Heading out on an epic adventure, Andy finds a lost baby triceratops, who has become separated from its family because of a thorn in its foot. Andy sets about removing the painful thorn, then reunites the baby with its family, before finally completing his important mission.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Miss Berrington, Evie's new school teacher, and teaching assistant Mr O'Donnell have come to meet Evie at home before term starts, and Waffle is under strict instructions to be on his best behaviour. But Waffle is teething, and won't stop chewing everything in sight.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Finn puts on a magic show at the bakery and wants to do it all by himself. It goes well - until he gets stuck. Rafi secretly makes a wish, and suddenly his hat is full of bunnies! The crowd laughs, but Finn is upset that the show isn’t his anymore. With Ruby’s help, they use carrot cake to guide the bunnies back into the hat. When the wish ends, Finn finishes the show on his own. He proves he can shine, and Rafi realises that friends sometimes need space to do things their own way.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are enjoying a Captain Chloe book in the garden. When Captain Chloe finds a treasure chest full of jewels, JoJo notices one looks a bit like Gran Gran’s necklace. Gran Gran explains that her necklace is her special treasure and shows JoJo her jewellery box. A call with Great-Gran Gran inspires JoJo to make her own jewellery.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Sarah is a seven-year-old girl with big eyes and a green hat, who lives with her quacky, flappy, slightly manic but endearing best friend, Duck. The pair embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck decide to spend a day at the beach and plan to build some sand animals.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Tiny has made up a lovely new tune to dance to. The Iron Chicken tries to join in but it is just too difficult for her to manage. Tiny and Small come up with a much simpler rhythm that the Iron Chicken can dance to - the Chicken Waltz!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa are jumping in puddles and notice a rainbow in the sky. It’s beautiful and colourful, but where does it end? They head to the Play Tree to find the rainbow’s end and draw pictures of rainbows. BaBa thinks the rainbow ends with the Yummies, but MeMo thinks it ends with Elewhale. They embark on a journey to find more rainbows all over Planet BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: The Tombliboos are playing their music so quickly that everybody does everything very fast. Igglepiggle and Upsy Daisy dance, and Makka Pakka washes stones until at last, the Tombliboos slow down.

programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Join Jason Momoa for the mighty tale of a tiny fish and his tall tales.

Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding safe, baby appropriate gloves inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun nursery rhyme ‘Incy Wincy Spider’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: Elsee plays I-spy next to a beautiful lake with her new friend Olivia.

programme.title: What’s in Your Plant Pot?
programme.desc: Worm farmer Heather and the Fact Pack get hands-on with wiggly worms! We learn how wonderful worms help plants grow.

programme.title: Let's Go for a Walk
programme.desc: Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers walk by the seaside and along the beach to build sandcastles. On the way, they make sounds using the wind, walk on the moon, spot windsurfers and even find a mermaid’s purse!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: The two friends celebrate the joys of greeting.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: When Indy and Rusty play Mums and Dads, they can't agree on who should go to work, so they part company. Indy has a hard time finding a babysitter, while Bluey makes Rusty her baby.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a very windy day, and the Squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly. Well done Squirrels! What brilliant flags!

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: We help Kush find out all about buzzy, busy bumblebees! Ferne visits a wildflower garden to find different types of bees, while Rory and his son Sandy visit the park looking for bumblebees. They then return home to build their own bumblebee house. Plus, we find out how bumblebees help to make a third of all the food we eat by a process called pollination.

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: George and Freddie love having fun! After a hearty breakfast, they fill their day with family 'eggsperiments', art, and even set up an obstacle course for Mum and Dad to complete. It looks easy at first… until they learn they have to do it blindfolded!

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen and Small want to cook pillow samosas for Princess Sprout, but they have run out of peas. Small flies on her spoon to find some in order to make the perfect recipe.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Kika and her family are on a day out to the Woofton Transport Museum. But when their new audio guide starts malfunctioning, Kika needs her supersight to race back through the museum.

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s a new day, and Mrs Farrell is checking in with all the children to see how they are. Lucas tells her he is looking for more friends to play with, and there are lots of volunteers! Isla, Otto and Jud bake some delicious tiger ginger biscuits, using coloured icing for roar-some decorations. At playtime, Jud asks if she can play with Lucas, and they have a fun-filled game of chase. The day ends with carpet-time, and Lucas is happy with his new-found friends.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Waffle is an adorable talking dog who can't help but cause trouble! His everyday adventures are full of mayhem and mischief. Warning: theme tune guaranteed to stick in your head.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Baba isn't well and needs to rest in the burrow. Oona has an idea to help him feel better. She travels across the island asking their friends to help her with her plan - they're going to bring Baba all his favourite things. Oona begins to doubt herself when it seems like Baba's not so interested in them - until their friends arrive!

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: TapTap’s loud, fast drumming is driving everyone in the garden to distraction. Can Yukee and Twinkle find a way to show TapTap that fast doesn’t necessarily have to mean loud?

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs want to get their toy train all the way from Phillipsburg to Maddiesville, but Phillip is finding it hard to let go of his dream track layout. Can he find a way to listen to Maddie's ideas so that the train can keep going round and round?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: It's the hottest day of the year in Fine Forest. The Piggies build an ice machine for cold drinks. Wilf wants it all to himself - and accidentally causes a blizzard!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Welcome to Ten's Place, where trainer Ten puts her friends through their paces with a high-energy number workout. Learn about numbers that are 'ten-and-a-bit' with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The Alphablocks join in with a singalong song, in which birds sing and bells ring. This episode introduces the '-ng' digraph and the words sing, song, ring, king, ting, ping, ding, dong, pong and bang.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin goes on an outdoor adventure with his friend. They build a den, meet an owl and sing around a campfire. Meanwhile, the Tumble family go on a camping trip, but Aunt Polly's snoring keeps everyone awake!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pretend to fly. Po goes so fast on the scooter that it starts to fly over Teletubbyland! The children in Tummy Tales watch swans flying.

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Baby elephant Kipekee learns how to get rid of some buzzy flies with the help of her friends. Ranger Hamza spots lions in the wild and has fun playing with the baby rhinos.

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the name bracelet and remembers the day she got it… Daisy is wearing a bracelet the others haven’t seen before. It’s a name bracelet with her Nigerian middle name, Eniwaju, on it. Her grandmother gave it to her. Molly has the idea to make their own name bracelets. Eilidh tells Daisy that she also has a Nigerian middle name; Ayodele. Meanwhile, Mack is doing a favour for Alice. He is posting a Japanese puzzle box from her stall to a customer. The only problem is, he can’t find it amongst all of Alice’s near and far treasures. When he finally spots the puzzle box, Suki and Molly give him a fright, and he drops it!

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies' very own motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing green machines! Grace drives a futuristic solar racecar, shows off an electric ferry and goes fishing for rubbish in a boat made out of recycled plastic bottles.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: It's show and tell day, and it's Bertie's turn to share why he loves gardening with the class. The pups are keen to give it a go but haven't fully listened to how it should be done. When Bertie mentions digging, Dodge gets carried away. Together with the pups, they end up ruining the garden. Bertie gets cross and feels upset. Dodge and Bertie both realise their mistakes, apologise, and become friends again.

programme.title: Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Ginger discovers some unexpected guests hiding in her tail - three baby Pea-Rexes.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: When a blizzard hits, Captain Barnacles will need to use all his Arctic survival tactics.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Cheeky Peter Rabbit loves adventure but he struggles to stay out of trouble. Luckily his best friends are always around to help him out. Based on Beatrix Potter's classic stories.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Join Duggee, a big, lovable dog, as he runs the Squirrel Club, where children can earn badges for learning new skills. Warm-hearted preschool series about trying new things.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Banjo gets a worry tummy when he paints a mural for everyone in Sweetwood.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea cheats Chilli out of winning floofy teddies at a funfair made from sweets, so Supertato and the Veggies must get the teddies back before it’s too late!

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings, the Eaglets and the Chipmunk are having a race! When Weasy realises that his Ducklings are going to lose, he decides to cheat - but Papa Eagle sees through his scheme.

programme.title: Do Not Watch This Show
programme.desc: Wizz discovers a secret pirate map but wants to find the gold before you can see it.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners, so he can ask Mum out on a date.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Both Uncle Rad and Frisky accidently turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Feeling unappreciated, Gadabout discovers a talent for gardening. Zog and Pearl discover his green fingers have upset the natural balance of the land, making others ill.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is tracking all the dinosaurs on Dino Island to find out when they move from one part of the island to another in search of food or shelter. She asks Andy to find a herd of triceratops and place one of her tracking devices on them. Heading out on an epic adventure, Andy finds a lost baby triceratops, who has become separated from its family because of a thorn in its foot. Andy sets about removing the painful thorn, then reunites the baby with its family, before finally completing his important mission.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Miss Berrington, Evie's new school teacher, and teaching assistant Mr O'Donnell have come to meet Evie at home before term starts, and Waffle is under strict instructions to be on his best behaviour. But Waffle is teething, and won't stop chewing everything in sight.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Finn puts on a magic show at the bakery and wants to do it all by himself. It goes well - until he gets stuck. Rafi secretly makes a wish, and suddenly his hat is full of bunnies! The crowd laughs, but Finn is upset that the show isn’t his anymore. With Ruby’s help, they use carrot cake to guide the bunnies back into the hat. When the wish ends, Finn finishes the show on his own. He proves he can shine, and Rafi realises that friends sometimes need space to do things their own way.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are enjoying a Captain Chloe book in the garden. When Captain Chloe finds a treasure chest full of jewels, JoJo notices one looks a bit like Gran Gran’s necklace. Gran Gran explains that her necklace is her special treasure and shows JoJo her jewellery box. A call with Great-Gran Gran inspires JoJo to make her own jewellery.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Sarah is a seven-year-old girl with big eyes and a green hat, who lives with her quacky, flappy, slightly manic but endearing best friend, Duck. The pair embark on simple but exciting adventures, exploring the world both near and far in their own wobbly and imaginative way. Sarah and Duck decide to spend a day at the beach and plan to build some sand animals.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Tiny has made up a lovely new tune to dance to. The Iron Chicken tries to join in but it is just too difficult for her to manage. Tiny and Small come up with a much simpler rhythm that the Iron Chicken can dance to - the Chicken Waltz!

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa are jumping in puddles and notice a rainbow in the sky. It’s beautiful and colourful, but where does it end? They head to the Play Tree to find the rainbow’s end and draw pictures of rainbows. BaBa thinks the rainbow ends with the Yummies, but MeMo thinks it ends with Elewhale. They embark on a journey to find more rainbows all over Planet BeddyByes.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: The Tombliboos are playing their music so quickly that everybody does everything very fast. Igglepiggle and Upsy Daisy dance, and Makka Pakka washes stones until at last, the Tombliboos slow down.

programme.title: Plebs
programme.desc: Sitcom set in ancient Rome. When the boys bump into old school friend Fabianus, who is now a hotshot lawyer living the high life in the city, Stylax reconnects with old flame Cordelia through him - meanwhile, Grumio finds something unusual hiding in their wardrobe...

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. It's Diversity and Inclusion Week and The Brimble, the most 'woke' girl at the school, has convinced the headmaster that the pupils should be set the task of pairing up with their polar opposite and present their differences and common ground in a presentation. Mo, who has fancied The Brimble for ages, spots his opportunity to try and impress her by suggesting they team up as he is a devout practising Muslim (he's not). Fascinated by his alleged faith, The Brimble leaps at the chance and asks if she can come to his house to observe a real Muslim family - keen to keep up the pretence, Mo calls his non-practicing Muslim parents and begs them to help him out. They agree... but when Mo and The Brimble arrive at the house, it becomes apparent that they are going to teach their son a life lesson about truth and faith.

programme.title: G'wed
programme.desc: Comedy series providing an honest, uplifting and heart-warming portrayal of the lives of working-class teenagers from Liverpool while tackling issues with a refreshing humour. Ted is the envy of the school as he starts dating popular sixth-former Thomas - Ted finds Thomas's talk of their spiritual connection beguiling, and their electrifying romance is cemented when Thomas takes Ted to see the Gormley statues on Crosby Beach for the very first time. This is a side of Liverpool that Ted never knew existed and a way of looking at the world that captures his heart and imagination, but for all Thomas's talk of them being soulmates, Ted is left with a decision to make when it is revealed that his older lover is exploring ethical non-monogamy. Meanwhile, Mia-Louise is worried that Ziad might be gay as he doesn't want to have sex with her, Mo is still acting like a devout Muslim in the hope of getting closer with The Brimble, and Christopher and Aimee bond over their Romeo and Juliet scenes.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex
programme.desc: It seems the only way is the Dominican Republic! The Essex crew are back and in full holiday mode - Essex's very own Ken and Barbie, Amber and Dan, are defiant when Dan becomes the hot topic of conversation as a voice note makes the rounds insinuating that Dan got too friendly on a night out with one of Amber's least favourite people! Meanwhile, Lockie has brought his friend Jordan along on the trip and continues with big lifestyle changes including rebuilding his friendship with ex-girlfriend Yaz. Yaz also welcomes good friend Junaid, who is a well-known face in Essex, but where are his allegiances when it comes to his old friends Courtney, Chloe M and Amber? After back-to-back to fights with Billy, Amy is re-assessing their relationship and testing if absence really makes the heart grow fonder - she is also on hand to lend a sympathetic ear to Saff, who is about to turn 30 and is really not looking forward to this milestone birthday.

programme.title: The Floor US

programme.desc: Reality series following the lives, loves and scandals of a group of real-life Essex guys and girls. Meanwhile, Amy is devastated that she and Billy will be spending their one-year anniversary on different sides of the world, but when there's a surprise knock on her hotel door, will Amy know she made the right decision to stick with Billy? Elsewhere, it seems that new lad Jordan has had one girl on his mind, but when he finds out that Ella's arrived on the island, will he make the move to make her his girl?

Everyone reunites when Gretchen hosts a tactical training event - the ladies learn self-defence here, but a shocking rumour about Tamra leads to an explosive confrontation.

programme.title: The Only Way is Essex

programme.title: Look At Life Model World
programme.desc: 1960. Starring: Peter Cushing. A look into the different types of models that can be found all across Britain.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Secret Mission. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. The Sheriff of Nottingham offers to pardon Robin if he pledges allegiance to King John. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: Spy Aboard. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Richard Johnson & Danny Green. Tempest is robbed by the ruthless pirate Peg Leg and comes to the realisation that there is a spy aboard the Sultana. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Talisman of Sargon. 1961. Stars David Graham, Graydon Gould & George Murcell. The Supercar team are given the task of stopping Masterspy from getting control of the Talisman of Sargon. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Final Column. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Kay Callard & Christopher Lee. Albert Lake sacks Larry Spence after he passes a story to the Courier. He blackmails Lake's mistress, but it goes wrong. [S]

programme.title: Tomorrow at Ten
programme.desc: 1962. Thriller. Director: Lance Comfort. Stars John Gregson, Robert Shaw & Alec Clunes. A race against time when police have to find a kidnapped boy with a bomb that will detonate at 10 o'clock. [S]

programme.title: Dial 999

programme.title: Paratrooper

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: Friends. 1974. Stars Ian Cullen, George Baker & John Duttine. DC Skinner has his eye on a young amateur footballer for a series of car thefts in Seaport. But is he pushing the issue too hard? [S]

programme.title: Crow Hollow
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Director: Michael McCarthy. Stars Natasha Parry & Donald Houston. In a spooky mansion, one of three sinister spinsters tries to poison her nephew's wife to steal a large inheritance. [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart

programme.title: The Green Man
programme.desc: 1956. Comedy. Stars Alastair Sim, Raymond Huntley, George Cole & Terry-Thomas. A watchmaker turns out to be an assassin whose target is a leading politician but his plans are stalled. [S]

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Sydney Chaplin, Audrey Dalton & Jefferson Clifford. After several killings of thieves occur, a priest is then marked for murder after hearing a confession. [S]

programme.title: Cinebox Memories
programme.desc: A captivating jukebox film from 1963 of the Kessler Sisters performing their song Quando Quando Quando!

programme.title: Maigret

programme.title: The Saint - The Fiction-Makers
